company.name: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
✔️ Created the world’s 3 rd most impactful COVID-19 Dataset (Ranked 3 rd on Kaggle) by leading a team of graduate students
✔️ Raised $100K in research funding from KCDC, Microsoft, etc
✔️ Published the dataset in NeuralIPS 2020
✔️ Conducted collaborative research with Harvard and published in International Journal of Infectious Diseases 
✔️ Developed COVID-19 patient data collection and engineering tool to generate patient data in real-time

positions.title: Deep Learning Research Team Lead
positions.description: ✔️ Improved, trained, and deployed state-of-the-art deep learning models for service in a wide range of vision tasks, including AI avatar, OCR, colorization, depth estimation, and license plate detection

positions.title: CUDA Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
✔️ Built one of the world’s fastest deep learning Text-To-Speech engine (patented) by implementing state-of-the-art TTS model CUDA C++ and optimizing the throughput
✔️ Saved over 30M$ USD by accelerating deep learning engines 800% and reducing the number of required GPUs
✔️ Invited to showcase in front of President Moon at National AI Research Institute

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
✔️ Built real-time, low-latency, and fault-tolerant deep learning production server with Redis and RabbitMQ
✔️ Served TTS requests from Twitch while handling the highest number of requests than any other TTS

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
✔️ Solved large-scale real world problems with state-of-the-art machine learning models, specifically on real-estate value prediction and stock market trend prediction.

✔️ Collected and analysed massive amounts of real world data.

volunteerExperiences.description:
✔️ Fixed critical bugs in bilinear interpolation kernel.

✔️ Optimized dozens of the CUDA kernels in Tensorflow, accelerating throughput upto 450%. 

✔️ (ongoing) Utilizing Tensor cores more effectively which would make convolution operations 300% faster.

✔️ Accelerated the throughput of bilinear interpolation CUDA kernels by batching computations and better saturating the GPU arithmetic pipeline. 

✔️ (ongoing) Optimize FP16 and INT8 operations by reducing the amount of wasted bandwidth.
